values.quote: ''Contaminate'' deals additional {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|35% AP}} {{as|magic damage}} for each stack of ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'' on the target.

mechanics.claim: A nearby enemy with a Deadly Venom stack is required to cast Contaminate; only enemies afflicted with Deadly Venom are hit.
mechanics.quote: A nearby enemy with {{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}} is required to cast this ability.

mechanics.claim: Contaminate's per-stack physical and magic damage is based on the number of Deadly Venom stacks the target had at the start of the cast time, not when the damage lands.
mechanics.quote: ''Contaminate'' will deal the additional damage to targets based on the number of {{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}} stacks they had at the start of the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Contaminate deals its base physical damage once, plus the physical and magic per-stack bonus for every stack of Deadly Venom on the target (up to the 6-stack cap).
mechanics.quote: ''Contaminate'' deals additional {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|35% AP}} {{as|magic damage}} for each stack of ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'' on the target.
